Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.wmtslayer

Class WmtsLayer

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.wmtslayer.WmtsLayer
public class WmtsLayer extends Object
DTO for cascading WMTS layer details.

Maps the response body of GET /rest/workspaces/{ws}/wmtsstores/{store}/layers/{layer}.

Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.

Differences from WmsLayer:
WmtsLayer does not have WMS-specific fields (forcedRemoteStyle, preferredFormat, minScale, maxScale, metadataBBoxRespected, selectedRemoteStyles, vendorParameters). Instead, it includes the advertised field.
